name: Get Programs by Lead ID
summary: Shows every program that a specific lead is a member of.
whenToUse: When you want to see a lead's program memberships and their status in each.

query.name: filterType
query.label: Filter on (optional)
query.hint: Optional. Restrict the result to programs matching a field, e.g. filter this lead's program memberships by program id.

query.name: filterValues
query.label: Filter value(s) (optional)
query.hint: Optional. Comma-separated values for the filter above.

query.name: batchSize
query.label: Batch size (max per page)
query.hint: Optional. Maximum records per response (max 300). Leave blank for the default.

response.description: Array of program memberships: programId and the lead's membership details.
